counterparty_name.description: Name of the contact whose stored phone number exactly matches the other party (to_number outbound, from_number inbound); a contact saved in another format, such as with spaces, does not match. Requires contacts:read, else null.

duration_seconds.description: Billable seconds once the call has ended.

placement.description: How the call was set up: from the app or browser (webrtc), by ringing your phone first (callback), or received on your number (inbound).

transcript_status.description: null when no transcript was requested.

answered_at.description: Not recorded for app calls today: null.

cost.description: The recorded charge, decimal string with two decimals; null unless status is completed.

cost_so_far.description: Charge accrued so far, decimal string, only while status is active; null otherwise (including initiating and connecting). Counted from started_at, so it includes ring time until answered_at is recorded.

counterparty_name.description: Name of the contact whose stored phone number exactly matches the other party (to_number outbound, from_number inbound); a contact saved in another format, such as with spaces, does not match. Requires contacts:read, else null.

duration_seconds.description: Billable seconds once the call has ended.

max_duration_seconds.description: Time limit the balance allowed when the call was set up, while status is active. Derived from the balance, so it needs credits:read; null without it. Not recorded for app-placed personal calls today, so null for them.

placement.description: How the call was set up: from the app or browser (webrtc), by ringing your phone first (callback), or received on your number (inbound).

rate_per_minute.description: The per-minute rate fixed at call setup and charged for this call, decimal string with four decimals.

session.description: Callback calls only; null for app and inbound calls.

status.description: initiating, connecting, active, completed, failed, no-answer, busy, canceled; callback calls add ringing_you and ringing_them. New values may appear.

transcript.description: Always null today. Reserved for the call summary once reading summaries through connected apps can be enabled (Settings → Connected apps); until then expand[]=transcript answers 403 summaries_not_enabled.

transcript_status.description: null when no transcript was requested.

ring_number.description: The verified number that was rung.

current.description: The selected caller ID, E.164, when it is usable on the personal account; null when the platform default is used.

options.description: Every number the account may present as caller ID.

is_active.description: Whether it can be used right now.

status.description: verified, pending_validation, validation_check_failed, or the number's status for virtual numbers.

has_more.description: Whether more objects exist beyond this page in the direction of travel.
Whether more objects exist beyond this page in the direction of travel.

Whether more objects exist beyond this page in the direction of travel.

capabilities.description: voice, sms, mms as the provider reports them.

messages_opt_in.description: Whether messages on this number are readable through the API. Opt-in ships with messages; always false today.

renewal_at.description: Next renewal, or the end of the grace period while in grace_period.

status.description: grace_period: renewal payment failed; the number is kept until renewal_at.

billing_increment_seconds.description: Calls are billed in whole increments of this many seconds.

rate_basis.description: Whether the quote is priced from your selected caller ID or the platform default.

rate_per_minute.description: The per-minute rate the app quotes before a call; the rate actually charged is fixed at call setup and shown on the call's rate_per_minute. Decimal string with four decimals.

amount.description: Signed change to the balance, decimal string: negative for money taken from the balance (deduction: call, SMS, recording, transcription and number charges; refund: a store refund clawed back from the balance; debit: manual charges and transfers out), positive for money added (purchase, addition, promotion; credit: manual credits); adjustment carries its own sign. balance_after is the balance recorded after this entry. Amounts are rounded to cents, so a running sum of amounts can differ from balance_after by rounding.

balance_after.description: Balance after this entry, when recorded.

type.description: purchase, deduction, refund, debit, credit, promotion, adjustment or addition; new types may appear.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country, when known. Not stored yet: always null.

livemode.description: true for OAuth access tokens and live API keys.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone, when known. Not stored yet: always null.

apiKey.description: Personal API key (vc_live_ or vc_test_) sent as a bearer token; /v1 only. Self-serve key creation is not available yet.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization code with PKCE (S256). Public clients register by Client ID Metadata Document or Dynamic Client Registration.
